assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: premium apparel process-detail photo for a sourcing website
Primary request: A native high-definition square macro documentary photograph showing thick, flat screen-printed ink on ivory cotton: bold navy and coral abstract rounded shapes printed in crisp layered blocks, visibly flat and smooth on the cloth, with no puff or raised relief. This is one close-up crop of the fabric and print, not a collage.
Scene/backdrop: Ivory cotton garment fabric fills the frame, softly folded on a clean work surface.
Subject: Original abstract rounded geometric navy and coral screenprint with crisp edges and slight ink-on-fiber texture.
Style/medium: Realistic premium editorial textile macro photography.
Composition/framing: Square, tight center crop with print texture occupying the middle 70%; gently visible cloth weave and fold; useful for circular crop.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural studio window light, honest detail, restrained editorial palette.
Materials/textures: Ivory cotton fibers, dense flat plastisol-like ink, visibly flush with the fabric.
Constraints: Clearly distinguish screen printing through opaque flat layered ink; keep design original and abstract; no readable text.
Avoid: Raised puff ink, embroidery threads, transfer film, stars, letters, logos, brands, anime characters, trademarks, watermark, collage, grid, borders.
